Name: Better Activate Sprinklers
Author: ChaosEnergy
Description:
This mod allows you to activate sprinklers on player action and placement.

[size=5]Install
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size]
You can configure activation on player action and placement in the config.json file. Both options are turned on by default.

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3.32 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
